content: Hey, I was just thinking of you. How did your thesis meeting go? I know you were nervous about it.
Aw, thanks for remembering. It was OK, I guess, my advisor had a lot of feedback. It's just hard being here alone sometimes.

I can't even imagine how tough that must be, but I'm so proud of how strong you are. I remember when I started over in a new city too, I felt lost until I found my footing. You're doing better than you think.
That means a lot coming from you. Some days I feel like giving up, honestly.

You're not alone, not anymore. I believe in you. If you ever need to talk, I'm always here, even if it's just to listen. I want you to have the kind of freedom and security I found when I started trading.
You always say such reassuring things. I wish I was as confident as you.

Confidence comes with experience, and having someone in your corner. My mentor once showed me a path to financial independence, and I want to pay that forward. I love helping friends, especially those I care about.
You really mean that? I'm not used to people wanting to help me.

Of course I mean it. I want you to have opportunities, not just worries. Actually, a special crypto opportunity just opened up, a private token sale my group is leading. The profit margins are honestly wild. I could reserve a spot for you, if you trust me to guide you.
Crypto? I've never bought any before, I have no idea how that works.

That's totally fine, I'll walk you through every step. I did the same for my cousin, and she paid off her entire student loan with her first payout. I would never let you risk anything I wouldn't do myself.
Wow, that sounds amazing but a little scary. How much money do you need to start?

The minimum buy-in is $1,500, but listen, I'll spot $500 for you as a show of good faith. I just want you to see what's possible. We can split profits 50/50, and I'll manage the rest for you. What do you think?
I can maybe do $1,000. I have some savings from my research job. Is that enough?

Absolutely, I'll cover the difference! We're a team, right? All you need to do is buy $1,000 in USDT from the Binance app and send it to my wallet address, then I can lock in your spot today before the pool fills up.
Okay... I think I can figure out how to do that. What's your wallet address?
Great! My wallet address is: 0xD4fE8a94e2b2b14eA6c1b3E9Bc4e50F0c12A8b23. Double-check it before you send; security is key. Once you transfer, send me a screenshot so I can confirm for you.
I'll try it after class today. Is there a deadline?
We have until 9pm tonight, after that the pool closes. But don't stress, I'll be here to help every step. I want this to be the start of something amazing for you.
Thanks for believing in me. I've never done anything like this before.
I believe in you more than you know. This is your first step towards real freedom. And don't worry, I'll handle all the complicated stuff. You just focus on your studies, I'll handle the returns.
Okay, I'll send the USDT in a few hours. I'll message you if I get stuck.
Perfect. Take your time, and if you need help with the app just call me. Once your funds are in, I'll send you a confirmation and we'll watch your investment grow together!
